value.signature: fn compare_authority_account (candidate : & AuthorityAccount , selected : Option < & BoundaryContext > , consumer : & impl BoundaryConsumer ,) -> Checked < () >

review.body: { let Some (selected) = selected else { return Checked :: Unavailable (Inability :: UnavailableContext) ; } ; let context = match forward_consumer (consumer . required_boundary_context (selected)) { Ok (value) => value , Err (other) => return failed_checked (& other) , } ; if candidate . context != context . value { return with_premises (Checked :: Refused (Refusal :: Context) , & context . premises) ; } with_premises (match compare_account (candidate , consumer , & context . premises) { Ok (premises) => Checked :: Confirmed (Assessed { value : () , premises }) , Err (other) => failed_checked (& other) , } , & context . premises ,) }
review.item_premise: The conditional component comparison reads public supplied context, typed values and explicit evaluator premises; it retains inability and refusal separately. No production evaluator, authenticated history or deployment authority is supplied by this operation.
